events.intent: Record the settled official Task 3 initial state.
Execute the outbound leg of the table-setup transport rehearsal.
Open both grippers for the tableware pickup sequence.
Close both grippers for the transport grasp rehearsal.
Lift the bimanual transport pose.
Execute the return leg of the table-setup transport rehearsal.
Lower the bimanual transport pose.
Release at the dining-side transport destination.
Execute a short closed-loop base approach for the feeding rehearsal.
Move the left TCP to the start of the feeding corridor.
Insert the left TCP 4 cm along the robot-forward direction.
Hold the feeding TCP pose for at least three simulated seconds.
Retract the left TCP from the feeding position.
Return to the rehearsal origin before bean recovery.
Execute a short closed-loop approach for bean recovery.
Lift the left TCP for the recovery pour rehearsal.
Execute a 4 cm robot-forward recovery pour gesture.
Retract from the recovery pour gesture.
Return to the rehearsal origin for four cleanup cycles.
Close the left gripper for the plate cleanup rehearsal.
Lift the left TCP for the plate cleanup rehearsal.
Lower the left TCP at the sink for the plate rehearsal.
Release the left gripper at the sink for the plate rehearsal.
Close the left gripper for the cup cleanup rehearsal.
Lift the left TCP for the cup cleanup rehearsal.
Lower the left TCP at the sink for the cup rehearsal.
Release the left gripper at the sink for the cup rehearsal.
Close the left gripper for the bowl cleanup rehearsal.
Lift the left TCP for the bowl cleanup rehearsal.
Lower the left TCP at the sink for the bowl rehearsal.
Release the left gripper at the sink for the bowl rehearsal.
Close the left gripper for the spoon cleanup rehearsal.
Lift the left TCP for the spoon cleanup rehearsal.
Lower the left TCP at the sink for the spoon rehearsal.
Release the left gripper at the sink for the spoon rehearsal.
Record the final actuator and task-object state.
